title: Christ's Fragrance to the Saved and the Perishing
description: Paul thanks God, who always leads the apostles in triumph in Christ and spreads the fragrance of the knowledge of him. They are a fragrance from Christ to God, both among those being saved and among those perishing—for some a fragrance from death to death, for others from life to life. Paul emphasizes that they do not peddle God's word but speak with sincerity before God in Christ.
